hero.label: Made for Whatnot
hero.headline: Excited to Enhance Customer Experience at Whatnot!
hero.subheadline: I'm eager to join Whatnot's team and contribute to its dynamic growth in the marketplace. The role aligns perfectly with my passion for customer experience and startup environments.

whyCompany.title: Focus on online marketplaces
whyCompany.body: Whatnot stands out by creatively blending livestreaming and auctions in online marketplaces, offering unique customer interactions. I'm fascinated by how this approach fosters community engagement.

whyCompany.title: Thriving in early-stage energy
whyCompany.body: Joining an early-stage startup like Whatnot excites me because of the opportunity to actively influence and grow with the company. This hiring moment offers a perfect chance to be part of impactful change.

whyCompany.title: BDR skills for customer success
whyCompany.body: My experience at Copygen.ai in engaging clients and understanding their needs prepares me to enhance customer interactions at Whatnot. I am well-versed in building relationships that drive satisfaction and loyalty.

quote: Working at Whatnot is exciting because I can directly shape and improve customer experiences. I love the challenge of creating positive, long-lasting impressions.
